paper_title: Delaunay Triangulations in the Hilbert Metric
statement: In the Euclidean case, the in-circle test may be run from either △abc or △pab, but this is not true for the Hilbert geometry. In light of Lemma 11, we do not know whether the △pab has a circumcircle, so we run the test from △abc.
